Available Moonroof
When you’re at the wheel of Corolla, things always seem to be looking
up. Take the available moonroof, for example. It offers you an uplifting view
of not just the moon, but also the sun, the stars and the glimmering city.
Remote Keyless Entry System
Convenience is keyless. Corolla lets you lock and unlock its doors with
the touch of a button. And once you open the door, a warmly lit interior
welcomes you inside. The remote can also be used to pop open the
trunk. Even the alarm can be activated remotely.
You’ve Got the Power
With Corolla, every excursion is a power trip. For 2012, all Corolla
models offer power windows, power door locks and power outside
mirrors as standard equipment.

On Corolla, the Star Safety It’s standard equipment. Every Corolla is built with our advanced integration of safety
technologies, including Enhanced Vehicle Stability Control (VSC), Traction Control (TRAC),
System™ is not an option.
Anti-lock Brake System (ABS), Electronic Brake-force Distribution (EBD), Brake Assist (BA)
and Smart Stop Technology (SST). Armed with these active safety features, Corolla can
actually help you avoid accidents in the first place. It’s not every car that provides this
level of safety. Just every Toyota.
Enhanced Vehicle Stability Control (VSC)1 Electronic Brake-Force Distribution (EBD)
To help compensate for a loss of traction while cornering and help prevent To help keep the rear wheels from locking up during sudden braking situations, EBD redistributes brake force.
sideways slipping, Corolla utilizes Enhanced VSC. The system adjusts engine
power, braking and steering torque-assist control to help the vehicle follow Brake Assist (BA)2
the direction in which it is being steered. During emergency stops, BA is designed to detect sudden or “panic” braking, then add the brake pressure needed
to help prevent a collision.
Traction Control (TRAC)
To help maintain traction on wet, icy, loose or uneven surfaces, TRAC applies Smart Stop Technology (SST)3
brake force to the spinning wheel(s). At speeds greater than five miles per hour, when the accelerator is depressed first and the brakes are then applied
firmly for longer than one-half second, SST is designed to help the driver bring the vehicle to a complete stop.
Anti-Lock Brake System (ABS)
To help prevent the brakes from locking up, ABS pulses brake pressure to
each wheel, helping you stay in control in emergency braking situations.
